title: Preventing Trap Seal Loss in Drainage Systems
description: A P-trap relies on a standing water seal to block dangerous sewer gas from entering living spaces. Trap seal loss often occurs through self-siphonage when a fixture isn't vented properly, or through evaporation in rarely used fixtures. To protect the seal, ensure every trap maintains adequate vent distance based on pipe diameter and local code standards. For infrequently used drains, periodic flushing or installing an approved trap primer ensures the trap stays full. Understanding trap seal dynamics prevents foul odors and maintains sanitary conditions throughout the drainage network.
